rapport_notes: Repeat-referral customer, warm and pleasant rapport, minor hesitation but confident on pricing.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Is there on the price and the quote in general? Do you have any, any particular concerns or any important questions you want answers through this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised scheduling/cancellation/payment questions; rep said 'I'll give you all the answers for that in a little bit' and only addressed them near the end of the call rather than digging in immediately.

top_strength: Personalized the time estimate using a detail the customer volunteered (fold-frame beds needing no disassembly), building trust in the number given.
coaching_note: Their agenda question came after the date was already collected, and the resulting concerns (scheduling, cancellation, payment) were deferred rather than dug into — answer or acknowledge concerns closer to when they're raised.
